main_text.p: ἑκάστων singularum: & in aliis casibus si-mili modo.
Item ὁ καθ’ ἕκα, uel οἱ καθ’ ἕκα, singuli. τὸ καθ’ ἕν, uel τὰ καθ’ ἕ, singula. ἡ κατὰ μίαν, uel αἱ κατὰ μίαν, singulæ, similiter in aliis casibus.
main_text.head: Articulus cum aduerbio.
main_text.p: Art. cum aduerbio.Aduerbio additus articulus, uim ha-bet nominis adiectiui. Mar. 4. τοῖς ἔξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὰ πάντα γίνεται, Illis autem exteris omnia fiunt in para-bolis. Iob. 1. ἀφελόφεξας τὰ ἔσω αὐτῆς, τὰ ἔξω, Vallasti interiora eius & exteriora. Ioan. 4. ὑμεῖς ἐκ τῶν κάτω ἐστέ, ἐγὼ ἐκ τῶν ἄνω εἰμί. Ego e supernis sum, uos ab infe-ris estis. τὸ νῦν, in præsentia, τὰ ἐν ᾅδῃ, ea quæ apud inferos sunt.
main_text.head: Appendix.
main_text.p: Appēd.1.Atticis sæpe abundant articuli. ἐλάττω ἐγὼ ὀδ' ἕλων ἐλαχίστων. Spem habeo ne minimam quidem. Quod plerunque fit ante nomina numeralia, τὰ ὀκτωναίδεκα. Et dum præponitur superlatiuis, ὁ πάντων ὁ βελτίστος.

page.notes: Greek passages are printed in a small, worn type; some accents and breathings are doubtful and transcribed approximately. The margin note "Art. cum aduerbio." runs over two lines. The catchword "Attici" at the foot is treated as text. Some marginal and show-through marks were omitted.
